title: Structure a paper around its contribution and evidence
scope: Scientific article writing, with editorial adaptation to ML
summary: Explain one central contribution and organize results into logical steps supporting it. Give readers sufficient context, connect claims to evidence, plan an outline, and seek critical feedback.
interpretation: ResearchPi profiles provide editable outlines. Methodology is generated from the protocol and actual records; argument review remains a human task.
limitations: This guidance does not impose identical sections on theory, dataset, systems or survey papers. It does not replace venue instructions.
